change: prompt_template says 'Return ONLY the full updated content'; Agent-tool subagents WRITE that content to the target file in a scratch copy instead of returning it in chat
rationale: keyless Phase-1: the solver is a tool-using subagent, not a completion API; grading still reads only the file it wrote

change: fable effort rungs run via nested `claude -p --model claude-fable-5 --effort <rung> --output-format json` (exact tokens + real billed cost per call); .claude/agents/fable-{low..max}.md committed for future sessions but not hot-loaded here (agents dir did not exist at session start)
rationale: Agent tool has no effort parameter; agent-definition effort frontmatter requires the watcher to have seen the dir at session start; the CLI gives the knob now plus exact telemetry

change: fable trials run sequentially from a constant cwd so the 1h prompt cache is written once (~$0.47) and read thereafter (~$0.02), instead of 9 parallel cold writes
rationale: prompt caching is a prefix match keyed on identical system context; parallel cold calls each pay the 2x 1h cache write
